caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular object, specifically a door, depicted in a vertical orientation and colored in a light brown shade. The door occupies the central part of the sheet and is bordered by a darker outline. Inside the rectangle, there are four vertical panels, with two wider ones flanking two narrower, centrally positioned panels. Beneath the main drawing, there is a horizontal cross-sectional view of the door, rendered in black lines with hatched areas indicating the structure and dimensions. Handwritten dimensions are provided: the door is marked as 6 feet 2 inches tall and 3 feet 1 inch wide. The cross-section also contains additional dimensional notations such as “2 ½”, “7”, and “4 ¼”. The background of the sheet is a uniform, off-white color, and there is a signature reading “Geoffrey Holt” in the bottom right corner. The image contains no other objects or embellishments.
title: One of Original Inside Doors to Sacristy
